questions.question: Which input files does BK-497 fill in this PR?

options.label: All 22 with findings (Recommended)
options.description: Every entry § 2 bears on, by ID or by the catalogue's one-entry mapping (all but OP-22 and OP-23, which get nothing). It is one mechanical pass under one priming check, and closes BK-497 instead of reopening it before each session.

options.label: 19 named by ID
options.description: OP-01 plus the entries § 2 names literally. OP-12 (Q3 rename gates), OP-17 (Q1 key-value view) and OP-21 (Q4 Closing) wait. BK-497 stays open for them.

options.label: OP-01 only
options.description: Smallest diff. BK-497 stays open, and every later session is gated on another pass.

questions.question: Does OP-01's input also get Q4's shared rows, which bind every entry and not OP-01 alone?

options.label: Yes, OP-01 only (Recommended)
options.description: Q4's Error taxonomy, Retries, Timeouts, Consistency and Closing rows, plus note 7, go into OP-01's file. shared.md sends the error layer, timeout bound and Lifetime to OP-01's flow. Key validation and async parity are left out, because specs 052 and 053 (ground) already decide them.

options.label: Per-entry only
options.description: Strictly BK-497's wording. OP-01's session meets these questions with no comparable data beyond shared.md's homes.

options.label: Into every entry
options.description: Copies the shared rows into all 24 files. Each session sees them, at the cost of 24 copies of one table.

questions.question: How are the two borderline advisory notes handled?

options.label: Drop 1, keep 2 (Recommended)
options.description: Note 1 is a catalogue-level recommendation the catalogue already decided, and its counts arrive through the Q1 rows. Note 2 is copied verbatim to OP-05, labelled as the report's advisory note and not a decision. Its body only reports OpenDAL's specification.

options.label: Copy both verbatim
options.description: Note 1's per-entry items also go to OP-02, 03, 10, 11 and 20, which repeats the Q1 counts. Both are labelled advisory.

options.label: Drop both
options.description: Avoids any scope framing. OP-05 loses note 2's one new fact: status codes alone do not decide the error kind.

questions.question: Do Q1's table rows (count and use case) go to the entry the catalogue marks them a Form of?

options.label: Yes, with the denominator (Recommended)
options.description: For example OP-02 gets 'Multi-range read, columnar formats, 3/10'. The section opens with one line naming the ten comparables, so that 'n/10' can be read without § 1.

options.label: No, IDs named only
options.description: Only Q1's closing line (OP-07, OP-18, OP-24) is copied. Each 'Form of' session sees the catalogue row with no counts.
